message.jaymospowers.zfighter_branch_nee: a night to wake it under
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_branch_wai: Something deeper waits past this: the %s. It needs: %s.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_branch_ope: The %s is yours now. C at the top of your forms takes it, sneak+C steps back.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ego_on: Ego: the mirror opens. It grows with every blow, given or taken.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ego_spent: The mirror cracks. Ego is spent.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ego_rest: The mirror is dark for %s more seconds.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ego_cannot: You are too hurt to face yourself, or already in a form.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_scientist_: A tinkerer has set up a workshop near (%s, %s). They say he rebuilds fighters.
Hm. Nothing in you to improve. Next.
Come back when you have broken through your limits. I do not rebuild the unfinished.
You have power, but your body is a leaky bucket. Let me rebuild it. Bring me parts first:
Splendid! Now a test. My unit will fight you. Break it, and stay near my bench.
Pah, the unit is scrap. I built another, free of charge.
The test is over. Speak to the tinkerer to start another.
The test unit is down. Speak to the tinkerer: it is time for the operation.
You would not survive it like this. Heal first.
Lie still. This will hurt, and then it will not. Do not leave my bench.
The operation was interrupted. Speak to the tinkerer to begin again.
A fine piece of work, if I do say so myself.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_android_do: You wake on the tinkerer's table, rebuilt. Your ki is endless now and burns with no aura. You need no food, and you mend with iron or copper ingots (sneak + use), not bandages. Two android forms wait past your highest form.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_metal_begi: Your body fails. Something beneath the ice hums, and begins to rebuild you.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_metal_done: You rise rebuilt in metal: tougher, heavier, unbroken.
